description: §20.5 E-SESSION-VALUE — a bare `session` value-use inside a `kind="tool"` main. Codegen refuses it (`undefined /* E-SESSION-VALUE … */` placeholder); the refusal must fail the compile. Before s456 the refusal's sink was drained only by the web-app server emitter, so in a tool it was never reported: exit 0.
rationale: §2.2.1: a codegen path that cannot lower a construct SHALL emit a hard diagnostic rather than a silent stub. `session` is not a first-class value (§20.5); the refusal is the same wherever the server-mode emission happens.
